brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.

requirements.evidence: Piece at 0,0,0 full with hex-bin-full bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full) provides enclosed storage volume inside the hex cell.
Full top cover fitted at 0,0,0 (cover:0,0,0;full;top) closes the bin to form a box with a removable lid.
Cover magnets enabled via setCoverMagnets on=true at 0,0,0 full top – verified by toggling off then on (second call succeeded), meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Single-hex storage box: full hex base with full-depth bin for storage, topped by a full cover acting as lid. Lid closure is magnetic – cover magnets are set on (setCoverMagnets true) so the lid is held shut magnetically. Build passes checks with meshClash clear.
